name: Green Tea
methodDescription: Picked before oxidation begins. Pan-fired the same day.
specimenCopy: The same leaf as the Nilgiris black tea, stopped before it could darken. Green tea is not a different plant. It's a decision made within hours of picking — let it breathe or don't.

sensoryProfile.aroma: Steamed spinach, toasted rice, sea breeze
sensoryProfile.flavor: Clean, mineral sweetness with a delicate astringent edge and umami finish
